quantities.adv4: mean over seeds 0,1,2 of the 20-step adversary's KL (nats, mean over every position of every row) on rows 0-3 (the qwen_port text rows), recomputed in this job
quantities.adv128: the same adversary on all 128 rows, one shared source per site, seeds 0,1,2; adv128_mean = mean of the 3 readings
quantities.spread128: max/min - 1 over the 3 adv128 readings; infinite if min < 1e-6 or fewer than 3 readings exist
quantities.ci128: KL(clean || masked) with m = g, delta off, mean over every position of the 128 rows
quantities.ceiling128: KL(clean || uniform over the 151936 logits), mean over every position of the 128 rows

control.if_fails: stop before the 128-row stage: the apparatus does not reproduce the 4-row reading

ci128.basis: 0.13-0.18 per text row on the 4 port rows

ceiling128.basis: ln 151936 = 11.93 minus the clean entropy (cross-entropy 2.6-3.5 on the port rows)

P1_block_size.claim: the 4-row reading is high because one source over 4 rows can be tailored to them
P1_block_size.null: ratio > 0.5 (block size is not the main cause)

P2_spread.basis: the testbed's stop rule for 'read more rows per block'

reading.unusable_at_this_size: adv128_mean >= 0.5 * ceiling128 (the adversary drives the masked model at W0 at least halfway to a uniform output, so an update cannot be read against it) or spread128 >= 1
reading.note: exactly one branch holds for any finite or infinite spread128 and any adv128_mean; unusable goes to a pending-decision card for the user

edge_cases_checked: spread128 with a zero or missing reading -> infinite -> unusable; ceiling128 cannot be 0 (vocabulary 151936, entropy far below ln V); ratio with adv4 = 0 cannot arise because the control requires adv4 >= 10; ties at a threshold fall to the stricter branch as written (< vs >=)
